instruction: Candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. The man in the black cap and dark polo shirt (R1) stands on the right, facing left, placing his right hand on the shoulder of the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands on the left, facing right, looking back at him. Bright overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
